text: "Project" stays the word for what an issue builds or changes: one component, such as a rate limiter, with its ratified statements, its TLA+ model and its code, in a directory with an `.invariant/` folder. The gate checks each on its own and writes a receipt for each. The docs had never said so, and the word usually means a whole repository. @gitdek chose to keep it and define it in the README, since renaming it would touch the CLI, the dashboard and every doc.
